audit: Read-only focus-quality and mechanics sample audit, 2026-10-20
shared_usa_note: No shared_focus entries in live USA_1970.txt; rg of common/national_focus found Nixon IDs only in that file. No separate Nixon attachment found.
limitations: Static inspection and Clausewitz AST inventory only; no engine, live tooltip or multiplayer campaign test. No builder/validator scripts executed. Parser library imported without invoking its main.
Not an exhaustive proof that every modifier, agreement and branch works; independent representative provider/consumer/reward traces. Other agents audit other trees and shared systems.
Description quality judged by substance and project contract, not a minimum word-count threshold. Main MD itself contains short useful descriptions.
All-focus counts include mutually exclusive and leadership-specific alternatives; summed tree cost is not a playable route length.

findings.title: Published descriptions still contain design instructions and repeated implementation scaffolding
findings.observed: 284 of 313 Greek focus descriptions contain the formulaic Conditions section. Examples repeat only the title plus Greece exists;1970scenario; programme conditions remain met. Cyprus literally says Never transfer ENG bases implicitly, No generic land-doctrine effect carried over without checking the MD 2.0 doctrine system, and warns developers not to invoke the generic MD territorial ceasefire blindly. 163 USA focus descriptions repeat X is implemented through the established United States policy systems / Every lasting advantage is paired with a trade-off.
findings.consequence: These are notes about implementation rather than country-specific finished MD narrative. The repeated disclaimer does not explain the concrete political or economic change. Some texts are long enough by word count but still fail the requested quality.
findings.recommendation: Replace scaffolding with concrete institutions, local problems, historical policy and tension. Retain numeric effects in native reward tooltips and meaningful restrictions in availability.

findings.title: Greece repeats empty 20-PP steps throughout ordinary development branches
findings.observed: air_0 and air_1 each cost5 (35 days) and grant20 PP plus receipt flags. Together they consume70 days for40 PP before the first substantive air-policy choice. navy_17 costs7 (49 days) and grants20 PP plus receipt. AST scan finds57 grant helpers whose immediate non-bookkeeping payload contains only PP or stability (includes political roots and merges, not57 automatically invalid focuses). The repeated20-PP pattern extends into economy, army, navy, air and foreign-policy roots/intermediates.
findings.consequence: Players spend focus time on repeated ceremony or audits without a new capability, a useful policy or a substantial numerical reward. The receipt flags chiefly gate next focuses and funding retries; they are not a separate playable reward in the cited cases.
findings.route_context: air_0 -> air_1 -> air_2 -> air_4 is140 days,40 PP,+3.9% air mission efficiency and one25% electronics research bonus, with air_4 charging1% current GDP. It should be judged as a bundle, but the first70 days still lack a meaningful outcome. navy_17 is a merge before navy_19, not the terminal naval capstone.
findings.recommendation: Merge redundant opening/intermediate steps or give the existing audit/planning steps a concrete supported payoff. Rebalance route length and bundle together; do not blindly buff all57 helpers.

findings.observed: p1_mandate costs5 (35 days), requires ruling_party1 and ultimately sets only its applied receipt flag. p1_organisation then costs another35 days for+3% stability_factor through the p1 programme. The first actual p1_first_a/b economic choice is another50 days. The1970 country history already installs party1/Makarios III.
findings.consequence: The starting ruler has an additional empty mandate/unlock focus before his programme. This conflicts with the user preference against an over-focus merely to unlock the already-ruling party, and makes the branch feel padded.
findings.recommendation: Start the incumbent programme with a real policy or merge mandate and organisation. Keep actual party/leader runtime guards.

findings.classification: Confirmed source-level presentation requirement violation; final tooltip needs engine check
findings.title: Internal scenario/country-routing checks are exposed in focus availability
findings.observed: GRE air_0 availability places original_tag=GRE and IMP_is_1970_scenario directly in the visible block. CYP republic_at_ten likewise exposes original_tag, scenario and a compound human/AI reservation rule. Repeated Greek focus descriptions also print scenario boilerplate. Nixon roots expose an internal presidency flag and a fixed January1973 cutoff without a meaningful native rule wrapper.
findings.consequence: Raw routing and scenario plumbing crowd player-facing requirements. This is the exact class of checks AGENTS asks to hide while retaining execution guards.
findings.recommendation: Wrap internal scenario/country/AI routing in hidden_trigger. Keep actual membership, governing party and meaningful gameplay conditions readable. For Nixon expiry communicate the presidential term meaningfully; do not remove the runtime cutoff.
findings.confidence_note: Direct visible-block placement is proven in source; rendering and exact native labels should be checked in a running1970 campaign.

positive_examples.assessment: Sampled mechanisms use real MD data paths rather than unconsumed reward variables.
positive_examples.observed: Spanish democratic cabinet refresh removes prior tier spirits and grants only the highest earned tier for the actual ruling party within the consolidated democratic system. A sampled PCE policy charges$1.5bn,changes the social-spending law and distinct faction opinions,records its tier and refreshes. USA_change_doti_construction_speed_change writes doti_construction_speed; the initialized Department of Interior dynamic modifier actually reads it into production_speed_buildings_factor. These sampled benefits are not inert custom variable labels.
positive_examples.limitation: This is not an exhaustive transition audit outside the Spanish refresh outer conditions and not a blanket quality pass for Spain or USA.

main_md_benchmarks.observed: A real naval package: accident chance-3%,mine-hit chance-3%,positioning+2%,dockyard output+4%,naval speed+4%,range+4%,naval AA+3%,amphibious invasion+3%; native modifies_dynamic_modifier heading and separate signed numeric variable rows. Description is only18words but gives a coherent naval restoration objective. This disproves a universal minimum prose-length rule; compare meaningful content and payoffs.

Native dynamic modifier heading plus+2% productivity growth and+2% factory output. Description names German Development Service and explains its institutional reform,development goals and operations instead of implementation metadata.

duration_assessment: No general too-short finding from costs: Greece mostly35/49days,Cyprus35/50/60days,Vietnam299of307focuses70days,Spain mostly35/49days,USA ordinary later modules mostly60.2days. Main MD uses e.g21day military packages too. The stronger issue is what the route delivers per slot, not imposing a universal70day duration.
